scope.liveClaimReadings: Five initial readings retained below; these do not establish comprehensive clinical verification.
scope.studyPopulationReview: All 270 reports retain their non-empty population, regimen, duration, outcome and citation fields. This is a context/projection audit, not a fresh verification of 270 studies.
scope.clinicalAndRegulatoryClaims: Not certified current, effective, approved or safe. PK and community regimens are not dosing guidance.

rightsDecision.authoredMaterial: The owner's source handoff identifies the included checked-in research as authored material, and the owner explicitly requests publication into their public repository.
rightsDecision.thirdPartyMaterial: Publish citations and bibliographic metadata, not publisher pages, images, excerpts or ignored caches. Source and target repository ownership does not grant rights to third-party full text.
rightsDecision.licensing: The target MIT licence covers the repository's authored work, not the external works cited. A private source repository without a detected licence is not itself a finding of infringement or a bar to the owner's instructed publication.

publicationCriteria: Historical reference only: no claim of fresh clinical, regulatory, dose, efficacy or safety verification.
Read all 163 community descriptions; retain original claims with individual review dispositions, and make unverified accounts explicit, collapsed by default and separate from studies.
Flag identified support, formulation, route, population and unit limitations without rewriting the immutable source.
Preserve all 210 identities, 270 study reports, 163 community descriptions, citations and 130 dated findings; never treat circular provenance as independent evidence.
Retain commercial citations solely as labelled historical provenance under the approved lossless-import scope; no vendor recommendations, affiliate links or purchasing directory.
Publish only allowlisted fields. Keep app defaults, templates, rejected drafts and the provenance/audit files out of generated output.
Record URL availability separately, including failures, without bypassing barriers or equating retrieval with source support.
knownLimitations: Source availability is not clinical claim validation. Inaccessible citations remain historical references, not confirmed current sources.
The historical-source release does not endorse every imported claim. Unverified account wording is retained for traceability, not asserted as fact.
Two bounded diary/traditional-use matches are not efficacy or dosing approvals.
No third-party licence clearance or medical certification is claimed.
availabilityNotes: All 888 registered citation URL identities are covered. The 142 same-day community checks were reused with their original timestamps.
Errors and possible barriers are not fresh source support. Two patent-host TLS certificate failures and an unsafe DOI redirect were not bypassed.
Hashes identify only retrieved bytes; capped responses are partial, not complete publisher snapshots. No publisher body or excerpt is stored.
The 28 unique wiki URLs represent circular provenance, not independently retrieved corroboration.
